questions.question: In which projected year is the total U.S. resident population expected to reach its peak in the main series?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_population_projections_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='Main series', header=None)
df_data = df[pd.to_numeric(df[0], errors='coerce').notna()].copy()
df_data[0] = df_data[0].astype(int)
df_data[1] = pd.to_numeric(df_data[1], errors='coerce')
peak_year = df_data.loc[df_data[1].idxmax(), 0]
result = str(peak_year)

questions.question: What is the cumulative number of projected births in thousands from 2023 through 2030 in the main series?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_population_projections_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='Main series', header=None)
df_data = df[pd.to_numeric(df[0], errors='coerce').notna()].copy()
df_data[0] = df_data[0].astype(int)
df_data[4] = pd.to_numeric(df_data[4], errors='coerce')
result = int(df_data[(df_data[0] >= 2023) & (df_data[0] <= 2030)][4].sum())

questions.question: Does projected net international migration ever reach or exceed one million people in any individual year between 2023 and 2100?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_population_projections_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='Main series', header=None)
df_data = df[pd.to_numeric(df[0], errors='coerce').notna()].copy()
df_data[0] = df_data[0].astype(int)
df_data = df_data[(df_data[0] >= 2023) & (df_data[0] <= 2100)]
mig = pd.to_numeric(df_data[7], errors='coerce')
result = 'yes' if (mig >= 1000).any() else 'no'

questions.question: How many years between 2023 and 2100 are projected to experience an annual decline in total population?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_population_projections_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='Main series', header=None)
df_data = df[pd.to_numeric(df[0], errors='coerce').notna()].copy()

questions.question: In the year 2040, by how many thousands are projected deaths expected to exceed projected births?
questions.program:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('census_population_projections_2023.xlsx', sheet_name='Main series', header=None)
df_data = df[pd.to_numeric(df[0], errors='coerce').notna()].copy()
df_data[0] = df_data[0].astype(int)
row_2040 = df_data[df_data[0] == 2040].iloc[0]
births = float(row_2040[4])
deaths = float(row_2040[5])
result = int(deaths - births)
